title: Unit cancellation for morphisms between Cech completed objects
statement: Let C be a small category with Grothendieck topology J, O a sheaf of commutative rings, r a natural number (possibly zero), and b a Fin r-indexed list of global sections of O. Assume the unbounded derived category of O-module sheaves. Put L=RHom(C_b,-) and eta:E→L(E) using the actual augmented Cech complex and unit of [def-weil-pbc-ringed-koszul-system]. For all derived objects E,Y, precomposition with eta_E is injective on morphisms L(E)→L(Y). No ideal subsheaf, tower category or slice restriction hypothesis is required.

proof.text: 1. Descend evaluation at one on functorial K-injective representatives to a natural transformation from the identity to internal Hom from the ring complex. Naturality of the augmentation-induced map gives naturality of the actual Cech completion unit.

2. Use the invertibility of L(eta_E) and eta_(L Y). Given eta_E f=eta_E g, apply L and cancel L(eta_E) to get L(f)=L(g). Unit naturality rewrites f eta_(L Y) and g eta_(L Y) as eta_(L E)L(f) and eta_(L E)L(g). Cancel eta_(L Y) to obtain f=g.

proof_origin.note: Naturality and the categorical cancellation argument are complete Lean proofs from the two actual idempotence maps.
